name: Self Mutilation
overview: Scripture clearly forbids self-mutilation practices such as cutting the flesh or marking the body, particularly in mourning, as seen in Leviticus 19:28 and Deuteronomy 14:1, affirming God's authority over the body. Instead of resorting to harmful actions, believers are called to cast their burdens upon the Lord, who sustains the brokenhearted and contrite in spirit (Psalms 34:18; 55:22). The Bible warns that sin harms the soul itself (Proverbs 8:36) and encourages transformation through the renewing of the mind to align with God’s perfect will rather than conforming to worldly patterns (Romans 12:2).
